annotations.title: Audit tracking & cookie consent (GDPR / Consent Mode v2)

description: Loads the site in a real browser three ways (no click, Reject, Accept all) and reports which tags fire before consent or after Reject, tracking cookies set without consent, Google Consent Mode v2 signals, broken GA4/GTM tags, duplicate page_views and missing conversions. Returns a score, prioritised plain-English fixes and a link to the full HTML report. Use for GDPR/UK GDPR/PECR/ePrivacy cookie compliance and "why is my analytics data wrong" questions. Runs on the caller's own Apify account (APIFY_TOKEN) and is billed by Apify pay-per-event; nothing is charged by this server.

internalPages.description: Extra internal pages to check per scenario (0 = home page only).

locale.description: Browser language, e.g. en-GB, de-DE, fr-FR (banners are often localised).

maxCostUsd.description: Spend cap for this run on YOUR Apify account (forwarded to Apify as maxTotalChargeUsd). Default from server config ($2).

scanMode.description: "full" = 3 visits (no click / Reject / Accept all). "quick" = 1 visit, cheaper: tag inventory, pre-consent tracking and broken tags only.

timezoneId.description: IANA time zone, e.g. Europe/London, Europe/Berlin, America/New_York.

url.description: Public website URL, e.g. "https://example.com" (https:// is added if missing). Private/internal addresses are rejected.

waitSecs.description: How long to wait for results before returning status "running" with a runId (the scan keeps going; use get_audit_results). Default 240.

name: audit_tracking_consent

dryRun.description: true = sample data from the built-in mock, NOT a real scan

id.description: Stable identifier of the rule/check that produced the finding

impact.description: Business, legal or revenue impact in plain words

reportUrl.description: Full report (HTML/JSON) in the Apify key-value store

status.description: Apify run status: SUCCEEDED, RUNNING, FAILED, TIMED-OUT, ABORTED, or DRY-RUN

usageTotalUsd.description: Cost of the run on the caller's Apify account, when Apify reports it

status.description: "running" = the Actor is still working; call get_audit_results with run.runId later
